Valus/For schools

For HOSA advisors and schools

Free HOSA chapter tools for schools

Talent is everywhere; resources aren’t. Valus gives every school’s HOSA chapter the study material and chapter tools that well-funded programs have built over years, for free.

Set up your chapterSee all events

What advisors get

  • Free for every school

    Instructors and students pay nothing. Any HOSA chapter can join, whether it is brand new or has competed for years.

  • Private chapter space

    Students join your school with a chapter password you control, and posts stay inside your chapter.

  • Assignments

    Assign work to the whole chapter or to the students in one event, and read their responses.

  • Roster and analytics

    See every student, the event they chose, and their progress through lessons and practice tests.

  • Ready-made curriculum

    650 lessons and 88 practice tests across all 64 secondary events, so advisors do not have to build study material from scratch.

  • Built for health science classes

    Lessons follow the official HOSA test plans and cite their references, which makes them useful alongside health science and CTE courses.

Getting your school started

  1. Create a teacher account with Google or email.
  2. Share your chapter password with your students.
  3. Students choose their events and start the lessons and practice tests.
  4. Assign and track work from your dashboard through competition season.

Valus is an independent study project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by HOSA–Future Health Professionals. Always confirm requirements in the current official guidelines and with your chapter advisor.
